#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
//  MinCostMaxFlow implementation (GNU C++11, simple version)
// ------------------------------------------------------------

typedef long long ll;

const ll INF = 1LL << 60;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    ll cap, cost;
    Edge(int to, int rev, ll cap, ll cost) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap), cost(cost) {}
};

struct MinCostFlow {
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<ll> h, dist;
    vector<int> prevv, preve;

    MinCostFlow(int n) : n(n), g(n), h(n, 0), dist(n), prevv(n), preve(n) {}

    void add_edge(int from, int to, ll cap, ll cost) {
        g[from].push_back(Edge(to, (int)g[to].size(), cap, cost));
        g[to].push_back(Edge(from, (int)g[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
    }

    // Returns {flow, cost}
    pair<ll, ll> min_cost_flow(int s, int t, ll maxf) {
        ll flow = 0, cost = 0;
        fill(h.begin(), h.end(), 0);
        while (flow < maxf) {
            priority_queue<pair<ll, int>, vector<pair<ll, int>>, greater<pair<ll, int>>> pq;
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            pq.push({0, s});
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                int v = p.second;
                if (dist[v] < p.first) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[v].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge &e = g[v][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost + h[v] - h[e.to]) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost + h[v] - h[e.to];
                        prevv[e.to] = v;
                        preve[e.to] = i;
                        pq.push({dist[e.to], e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
                if (dist[v] < INF) h[v] += dist[v];
            }
            ll d = maxf - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                d = min(d, g[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            }
            flow += d;
            cost += d * h[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge &e = g[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= d;
                g[v][e.rev].cap += d;
            }
        }
        return {cost, flow};
    }
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------
//  Main solver
// ------------------------------------------------------------

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }

    // Build graph
    int V = n + 100;
    int source = V - 2, sink = V - 1;
    MinCostFlow mcf(V);

    // Connect pairs (i, n-1-i) to sink with capacity 2
    for (int i = 0; i * 2 < n; ++i) {
        mcf.add_edge(i, sink, 2, 0);
    }

    // Connect source to character nodes
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        if (cnt[i] > 0) {
            mcf.add_edge(source, i + n, cnt[i], 0);
        }
    }

    // Connect character nodes to pair nodes
    for (int c = 0; c < 26; ++c) {
        for (int j = 0; j * 2 < n; ++j) {
            int left = j;
            int right = n - 1 - j;
            // If both characters same, we can change only one to c
            if (s[left] == s[right]) {
                int w = 0;
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + c)) {
                    w = -max(a[left], a[right]);
                }
                mcf.add_edge(c + n, j, 1, w);
            } else {
                int w = 0;
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + c)) w -= a[left];
                if (s[right] == (char)('a' + c)) w -= a[right];
                mcf.add_edge(c + n, j, 1, w);
            }
        }
    }

    auto res = mcf.min_cost_flow(source, sink, n);
    cout << -res.first << endl;

    return 0;
}
